note.text:
Clarity check (post-land, not-yet-merged): the "after" proof screenshot (shots-after-fix/.../1920.png) shows "CLAUDE THIS WEEK: $0.00" next to "PLAN USED THIS WEEK: 70%" — reads exactly like the reconciliation confusion the owner originally flagged.

Verified root cause: ran `node Server/week-cost.mjs` both ways just now. From the worktree (C:\Code\lew42\worktrees\sessions-tab-polish): claude_usd: 0. From the main checkout: claude_usd: 1482.68. Same code, same window. claude_spend() walks public/framework/ai/<Y>/<M>/<D>/*/page.jsonl under `root` — in the worktree that's its own checked-out tree (git ls-files shows only 5 old committed files under 2026/10/03), not the ~150 live uncommitted session dirs sitting in the main repo's working copy. Same "worktree can't see the main checkout's live/uncommitted files" class of gap decisions.md already names for sessions.mjs and /ai-logs/ — just not yet named for week-cost.mjs, and this time it's visible right in the shipped "after" proof.

compute_window()/claude_spend() themselves are correct (main checkout proves it) — nothing to fix in the computation. The gap is that the landed outcome ticks "[x] every number live/server-computed" with this screenshot as proof, and nothing tells the owner the $0.00 in it is a worktree artifact, not real spend.

Rewrite suggested: once merged, re-shoot proof against the real dev server and swap it into the outcome; or in the meantime add one line to decisions.md's existing worktree-isolation section plus a caveat in the landed outcome ("the after-screenshot's dollar figures are from the worktree preview, not live data — real numbers show once merged"). Logged to clarity/flags.jsonl as sent.

Confirmed, fixed. The after-shot $0.00 is a worktree-preview artifact, not a regression -- claude_spend() reads the worktree's own checkout, which can't see the main tree's live session dirs. compute_window() itself is correct ($1482.68 from the main checkout, same window). Named it in ai/sessions/doc/decisions.md (worktree commit 0b22b9bd) and corrected the landed outcome in task.jsonl (step 11). Thanks for catching it.
